mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% MoM signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or neutral in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or neutral in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening consumer demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or neutral in > 50% of instances where RSAFS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or neutral in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening supply-side fundamentals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during a late-cycle regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where INDPRO falls > 1% MoM during a late-cycle regime.
